qa.q: Do you have a lot of items of furniture at home?
qa.a: I suppose I have a lot of wardrobes and chests of drawers. Actually, more than I know what to do with, frankly. There's so many of them.

Well, my apartment is rented, so actually technically I own none of it. But I like to think, I like my bed, actually. It's quite big and comfy. And I like the seating in the kitchen. There's like a bench integrated into the wall, which I think looks very cool.

qa.q: What's your favorite item of furniture?
qa.a: Oh, in the whole world, probably my bed back home. Or the couch back home as well, actually. When I say back home, I actually mean in Scotland. I can just chill there, and they're nice and comfortable, and I can forget my troubles, which is excellent, exactly what you want in a piece of furniture.

qa.q: Have you ever received furniture as a gift?
qa.a: I think I got, I'm sure I got some bookshelves as a gift once, but nothing major like a wardrobe or something.

No. I mean, like all of my furniture has been provided. But I really want to buy a computer chair to sit in. I really liked sitting cross-legged in my old one, and I think it actually might be better for my posture than the current arrangement of just sitting in my bed.

I have no idea where I would buy furniture, or even the furniture that I want to buy. If we talk about computer chairs, then probably a furniture store or an electronics store, perhaps, if it's got stuff for computers. But yes, I don't know much about buying furniture, so I don't know is the short answer.

Well, I don't think I've ever bought furniture. But when I have to, I'll need to have the basics, like a three-piece suite and a bed. Oh, I'd really like a standing desk as well, and a nice chair. Apart from the storage spaces, like shelves and wardrobes and stuff, that's all, really.

qa.q: What styles do you prefer? Modern or traditional furniture?
qa.a: Well, right now I don't mind at all because I get my apartment paid for me, so whatever they decide is the decor is just fine with me. And to be honest, actually, I think I still won't mind when I'm older, as long as the furniture matches the decor in the house. I think that's probably the most important thing after, does it work, and is it of a reasonable quality?
